correctness.rationale: The helper implements the required exit/result contract visible in the diff and Bats fixtures: INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults, allow-list load with API_ERROR on missing file, head SHA checks before and after each GraphQL snapshot with SHA_CHANGED exit 3, CONVERGED when unresolved allow-listed bot threads are zero and every participating bot has a review whose commit oid equals the current head, QUIET_ELAPSED when the quiet window elapsed since the latest actionable event timestamp, TIMEOUT at MAX_WAIT, API_ERROR on gh/jq/repo failures, and RESULT=/HEAD= stdout emission. One non-fatal gap: the script header KL-01 states thread-only bots should be terminal once all actionable threads are resolved, but terminal membership is derived only from on-head formal reviews, so a participating thread-only bot with all threads resolved would not satisfy all_terminal and would fall through to QUIET_ELAPSED or TIMEOUT instead.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear, maintainable, and repo-consistent: focused 253-line bash entrypoint with documented contract, emit() helper, inline GraphQL plus jq snapshot parsing, canonical bot-allowlist.txt with sync instructions, and companion updates to pr-resolve-all.md (preferred helper, exit-code branching table, preserved time-based fallback, pre-#321 scope note) and AI_REPO_GUIDE.md (tree and table entries). Bats use the repo stub-gh-on-PATH pattern. Minor deduction: jq logic is embedded in the script rather than extracted under scripts/lib/jq/ as used by peer helpers, and KL-01 documents behavior the jq terminal predicate does not implement.

process.rationale: Diff is tightly scoped to seven on-task files (helper, allow-list, bats, smoke check, scripts inventory, required prompt and guide updates) with no forbidden live-state surfaces, no PLAN.md or AGENTS.md churn, explicit pre-#321 boundary, in-memory-only state, and the documented time-based fallback retained per constraints.

reliability.rationale: Verification wiring is substantive and credible: pr-resolve-all-poll.bats exercises syntax, usage exits, API_ERROR paths, CONVERGED, SHA_CHANGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, and non-allowlisted thread exclusion via a stub gh; 141-pr-resolve-all-poll-smoke.sh invokes run_bats_check; 105-scripts.sh inventories new artifacts; objective evidence confirms bash -n, lint, and test_wiring pass. Objective bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in bundle-only grading, so full-suite pass is not confirmed here; smoke check does not add doc grep assertions; KL-01 thread-only convergence and GraphQL first:100 pagination edges are untested.
